method: Each rebalance's already-realized turnover and flat-10bps cost are used to recover value_before (cost = value_before * turnover * bps / 10000, solved for value_before), then re-priced at gross/optimistic/base/stress spread-only bps. Holds the realized portfolio-value path fixed; does not re-simulate compounding effects. No network calls.

per_name_liquidity_legs.reason: costs.estimate_cost_bps's tiered/impact legs need each traded name's own median_dollar_volume_60d and annualized_volatility on the rebalance date. pipeline/data/backtest_cache/ (per-name price/volume history) is empty in this checkout, and this session's network policy blocks fetching it.
